title: Beyond Understanding: Evaluating the Pragmatic Gap in LLMs’ Cultural Processing of Figurative Language

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing model comprehension, pragmatic use, and connotation interpretation of culturally specific figurative language (idioms and proverbs) across English and Arabic to identify gaps in local knowledge and cultural reasoning.

Measuring and comparing model accuracy on multiple-choice understanding tasks across 20 different Arabic regional dialects and Modern Standard Arabic (MSA) to identify performance disparities based on the resource level and geographic region of the language variety.
